item.title: Musk's clash with Ukraine accelerates demand for Starlink alternatives. Few exist
item.description: Governments or companies looking for an alternative to SpaceX's Starlink are faced with few options, as Amazon, Eutelsat and others are far behind.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says neocloud demand is 'off the charts' but capital is scarce
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC Thursday that demand for neocloud firms is "off the charts," but scarce capital is holding back growth.

item.title: Spain accuses Trump ally Milei of ‘disgraceful’ election interference
item.description: Argentinia's Javier Milei launched a barrage of insults at Spain’s left-wing Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on a visit to Madrid, calling on voters to oust him.

item.title: World's largest wealth fund posts $30 billion loss after bond market turbulence
item.description: The fund has a current value of around $2.3 trillion.

item.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he sees no sign of a 2029 memory glut: 'You can always use more'
item.description: Nvidia's Jensen Huang told CNBC that a surplus of memory supply is unlikely by 2029, as memory stocks have taken a beating in the past week.

item.title: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey
item.description: Eight out of 10 Americans now rate the economy as fair or poor, one of several findings in a CNBC poll that show why Republican candidates face uphill battles.

item.title: Third-party evaluators find vulnerabilities in OpenAI monitoring system during test pilot
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman pledged to grant independent evaluators "employee-like access" to the company to help address mounting safety concerns.

item.title: France protests: Macron condemns 'stupid' comments from Trump, others as bond market pressure builds
item.description: France is facing a mounting economic crisis that pushed its 10-year government bond yield to a new 24-year high on Thursday.

item.title: Sovereign wealth funds' China and Hong Kong investments surge 190% after a bruising slump
item.description: Sovereign wealth funds are pouring billions of dollars back into China after a sharp investment slump.

item.title: Barclays to slash 5,000 jobs in AI efficiency push
item.description: U.K. banks Barclays said Thursday it plans to cut 5,000 staff, citing efficiency savings from AI.

item.title: U.S. pulls diplomats from Saudi Arabia as it reportedly readies Iran strikes after midterms
item.description: The U.S. ordered non-emergency staff out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi strikes on an airport and an oil field, reviving fears of a widening regional conflict.

item.title: Critical PHP web security flaws spark global alarm as Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond
item.description: Critical PHP security flaws trigger global warnings as Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond to potential cyber threats.

item.title: China's stock market sinks into bear territory as CSI 300 extends 10-week rout
item.description: China's benchmark CSI 300 index has entered bear-market territory, falling 20% from its June peak, as a prolonged selloff in mainland equities deepens.

item.title: James Talarico fires back at Elon Musk in Texas Senate race feud
item.description: Musk in September donated $158 million to a Republican Super PAC, which sent that cash to a PAC backing GOP Senate nominee Ken Paxton, Talarico's opponent.

item.title: CNBC Daily Open: Ukraine's Starlink whodunit
item.description: Washington says it has no plans to renew strikes on Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms, but escalation may not wait long after that.
